summary: Learn Tekla Structures steel modeling, drawings, numbering, IFC exchange, and fabrication outputs in practical exercises. Explore the 10-day course.
lede: Tekla Structures training introduces beginning steel detailers, structural technicians, and BIM coordinators to building and reviewing coordinated steel models. The course covers project setup, steel member modeling, standard connections, numbering, and preparation of GA and assembly drawings. It also introduces model checks, revision review, IFC exchange, and NC/DSTV fabrication outputs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people beginning or expanding hands-on work with Tekla Structures models and steel detailing outputs.
modules: Tekla Structures and Steel BIM Foundations
Tekla Model Checking and Revision Control
prerequisites: No prior Tekla Structures experience is assumed. Basic computer skills and the ability to read structural or fabrication drawings are recommended. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced connection customization and automation are introduced at awareness level rather than taught as implementation skills.
